records.name: Tierarztpraxis d’Orazio
records.service_quote: In unserer Tierarztpraxis ... chirurgische Leistungen: ... Tumorchirurgie
records.clinician_quote: Paolo d’Orazio ... Valerie Pasquali ... Tierärztin für Kleintiere
records.clinician_review: The current team lists Paolo d’Orazio and Valerie Pasquali as small-animal veterinarians. No oncology or surgery board certification inferred from experience or cooperating specialists.
records.availability_note: Telephone or online appointments; veterinary referrals for surgical cases are explicitly accepted. Local tumor surgery is listed by this Hietzing practice. Confirm the assigned surgeon when booking.

records.name: Tierarztpraxis M. Zekic
records.clinician_review: The current official site identifies Mag. med. vet. M. Zekic. No oncology board credential is claimed; the initial is not expanded from an unverified external biography.
records.availability_note: Appointments required; contact via telephone, email or the published WhatsApp number. Explicit local tumor surgery. The advertised corner entrance at number 44 describes this same practice, not a second treatment branch.

records.name: Tierärztliche Ordinationsgemeinschaft Mauer — Daniela Kopp
records.clinician_review: The current official practice and team identify Dipl. Tzt. Mag. Daniela Kopp. No oncology board qualification inferred. Other staff are not assumed to be veterinarians.
records.availability_note: Appointment-only practice with telephone and online booking. Explicit local tumor surgery. This Maurer Lange Gasse 61 practice is distinct from Veterinaria Tierklinik Mauer at Kaserngasse 7 and from Vetklinikum at Laxenburger Straße.

records.name: Pfoten Tierklinik
records.service_quote: Operationen die bei uns durchgeführt werden: ... Tumorchirurgie
records.clinician_quote: Mag. Andreas Kroesen – Inhaber und Leiter der Pfoten Tierklinik Wien
records.clinician_review: Current clinical lead is Mag. Andreas Kroesen; Julia Höfler and Linda Wiesmüller are listed as assistant veterinarians. Oncology continuing education is not an oncology diplomate qualification.
records.availability_note: Telephone or appointment-request form; call for near-term appointments. Local tumor surgery is explicitly offered. The oncology explainer discusses chemotherapy, radiation and immunotherapy in general, but does not establish delivery of those modalities at this branch; they are not confirmed service tags.

records.name: Tierarztzentrum am Seepark
records.service_quote: Tumorchirurgie ... findet man in allen Körperregionen
records.clinician_review: Current team includes Melanie Popov (veterinarian and managing director), Tamara Melak and Dominika Formankova. Internal-medicine, orthopedics and CCRP qualifications are not oncology board certification.
records.availability_note: Telephone or email appointment consultation. The clinic’s own surgical services include tumor surgery; confirm the exact procedure and assigned surgeon at booking. CT and radiography are diagnostic imaging, not radiotherapy.

records.name: Tierarztpraxis Steininger — Kleintierpraxis Kottingbrunn
records.booking_quote: Buchen Sie Ihren Termin bequem online oder rufen Sie uns direkt an.
records.clinician_review: The current small-animal team is led by Mag. Annika Eder, with interests in internal medicine, anesthesia, dermatology and ultrasound. Horse-clinic personnel and credentials are not assigned automatically to dog/cat tumor surgery.
records.availability_note: Telephone or online appointments; morning appointments and afternoon open consultations are described. The small-animal service explicitly provides local tumor removal. Routine house calls do not establish mobile anticancer treatment. Horse emergency service is not represented as a dog/cat oncology emergency route.

records.name: Tierarztpraxis Rosental
records.clinician_review: The current practice is led by Mag. med. vet. Julia Jilge with Dr. Alexander Rabitsch also listed. Rabitsch’s animal-welfare expertise is not an oncology board qualification.
records.availability_note: Telephone or online appointments. The Ferlach practice explicitly has an operating area for tumor procedures in its small-animal service. Farm-animal work is not represented as a mobile cancer service.
